method: Every complete original hunk and every changed markdown path read. Mobile accessibility and zone guidance individually reasoned; the other three decisions also have exact per-SHA reasoning. No executable/source changes occur in any member.
scope: Five exact guide SHAs; no broad docs-prefix or sensitive-behavior exclusion

packaging.closure: Owned secondary entries/Sass/schematic assets; no upstream src/material or src/cdk markdown copied as assets

limitations: These source-only documentation decisions do not accept mobile screen-reader, FocusMonitor zone/lifecycle, tooltip ARIA, table sort delegation or icon security behavior.
Maintained guidance and public peer authored-use contracts still require A10/A03 review. All seed SHAs and uses remain in their original denominators.
